info.name: witchy search
info.description: The image features a cosmic background with phases of the moon at the top and the word "Witch" prominently displayed in the center. Surrounding it are various mystical symbols like crystals, hands, a candle, and a stylized witch's face, with the phrase "Écoute ton coeur et reprends le pouvoir!" which means "Listen to your heart and take back the power!" adding to the mystical and empowering theme.
